text:
maya: quick spike — thinking about a different angle for the launch narrative. instead of just avg latency vs $/token, what if we show a 2-panel: 1) tail-latency (95/99) for real user slices, 2) effective $/response after batching + prefix cache. short, punchy.

oliver: love that. can we make the user slices concrete? e.g. chat support (short turns), doc-summarization (longer seq), and code-complete (many short tokens but high qps).

sam: +1. for the cost side let's show before/after using our auto-batching + cache recommendations. headline: "Same model, 40% lower cost at 95th latency target" — quantitative and actionable.

camila: design note — avoid too many decimals. rounded percentages, 3 bars max per chart. and add microcopy explaining what 95th vs avg means in plain english.

maya: agreed. draft copy idea: "Optimize for what users see, not just the average. We make tail latency predictable while cutting per-response cost." short supporting line: "Real workloads, real savings." :sparkles:

kai: data QA: i'll pull the 95/99 numbers from the last perf run (region us-west2, gpt-*-like setup with kv-cache enabled). rough snippet i'll share:

```
scenario,avg_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_responses
chat-support,120,310,540,$12.3
doc-summarize,420,880,1300,$28.9
code-complete,90,240,470,$15.1
```

sam: nice. can we also include a tiny waterfall that explains where cost savings come from (batching, quantization, cache hit)? one-liner bullets under chart would work.

anna-brand: for social copy: "Latency you can promise. Cost you can measure." then 2 CTAs: 1) Try our hosted perf test 2) Join the webinar (date link). keep it <140 chars.

ci-bot: deploy status — perf-run/4850008 finished. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/4850008 :white_check_mark:

maya: timeline proposal: 1) kai shares cleaned numbers by EOD Thu, 2) design makes 2-panel mock by Fri AM, 3) copy short passes Fri afternoon, 4) webinar & inbound flow CTA go live next Wed. who wants to own storyboard?

camila: i'll own mocks.

oliver: i'll pair with kai on numbers + small table for blog.

sam: i'll draft the waterfall + the short appendix that explains methodology for the nerds.

maya: perfect. quick ask — keep the hero chart PNG export width >=1200 for socials. also, add a screenshot-friendly alt text for accessibility.

anna-brand: noted. will craft alt text and two headline variants (enterprise vs dev-first).

maya: great momentum. small experiment idea: for the webinar, run a poll asking "What matters more to you? Lower cost / Lower tail latency / Predictable throughput" — helps segment inbound.

sam: awesome — I can wire the poll into registration flow and route leads by answer.

maya: thanks team. we'll sync Fri 10am for preflight. :rocket:
